opening.title: For the one who makes every ordinary day feel heroic
opening.message: Four small pages are waiting here, each holding something I never want us to forget.

modules.title: Why You Matter
modules.subtitle: The little things that make you extraordinary.

modules.title: Our Soundtrack
modules.subtitle: Songs that always lead me back to you.

modules.title: A Letter
modules.subtitle: One last thing I need you to know.

items: You make ordinary days worth remembering.
You listen even when my thoughts are messy.
Your laugh is still my favorite sound.
You make me want to become a kinder person.
You always find light in the smallest things.
Being myself feels easy when I am with you.

items.title: The day our story changed
items.caption: Some moments quietly become the beginning of everything.

items.title: Still choosing you
items.caption: Across every universe, this is the one I would keep.

paragraphs: I wanted to give you something that could hold a few of the things I struggle to say out loud.
Thank you for every quiet kindness, every unexpected laugh, and every moment that feels lighter because you are there.
Whatever chapter comes next, I hope we keep choosing the same story.

finale.title: Across every universe
finale.message: I would still find my way back to you.
